name: wechat-learning-studio
description: Reverse-engineer good WeChat Official Account articles into reusable writing techniques. Discovers candidates by web search or user submission, grades them by verifiable substitute signals (repost breadth / teardown coverage / top-tier source / user designation) since read counts are not public, tears each article down across five dimensions (topic & angle, title & opening hook, structure & rhythm, emotional curve & resonance, golden lines & ending), produces a teardown report plus independent technique cards graded for transferability, and proposes SOP amendments to the writing workshop for explicit user approval — never auto-editing it.

displayDescription.en: Reverse-engineers good articles into reusable techniques: five-dimension teardown, technique cards graded for transferability, and a confirmed path into the writing workshop's rules.
displayDescription.zh: 把外部好文章逆向成可迁移的写作技法：五维拆解、技法卡分级入库，经确认后反哺写作规则。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我拆解几篇同题材的好文章，学它们的写作技巧，沉淀进技法库。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Tear down some good articles in my niche, extract their writing techniques, and sediment them into the technique library.

quickPrompts.en: Tear down some good articles in my niche, extract their writing techniques, and sediment them into the technique library.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我拆解几篇同题材的好文章，学它们的写作技巧，沉淀进技法库。

quickPrompts.en: Search for widely-reposted parenting articles about adolescence, grade the evidence, and give me a candidate list to pick from.
quickPrompts.zh: 搜一批青春期亲子题材被广泛转载的文章，标注证据等级，给我一份候选清单让我挑。

quickPrompts.en: Review the technique library and propose which findings are ready to be written into the writing workshop's SOP — I'll decide item by item.
quickPrompts.zh: 盘点技法库，提出哪些发现可以写进写作工坊的 SOP，我逐条拍板。
